# 3 bed terraced house for sale

> Mullery O’Gara are proud to present 12 St. Peters Road to the open market. A wonderful 3 bedroom plus attic room family home, well set back from the road with ample off street parking, south facing garden, garage and rear pedestrian and vehicular access. This wonderful home has been extremely well maintained by the current owners and is presented in immaculate condition throughout.

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 141 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C
- Lokalita: 12 St Peters Road, Walkinstown
